### 2026-10-11 302 DECISION: split into 302a (method module), 302b (one-shot held-out table), 302c (decision + site_done wiring + e2e test), 302d (Stonehenge run) - the method is ink-vs-relief, never model coordinates
    First session on this task (iteration 74): investigation only, no code written. The split files carry the
    per-step acceptance boxes; the parent hand-over carries the verified facts and the frozen design.
    Method choice (evidence, not hope): matching points = the plate's own ink (autowalls' frozen extractor,
    docs/autofit.md section 3) matched against the site's bare-earth relief with fit_plate's ridge-contrast
    objective (the 2026-10-09 Fudge proof: commit 16c6b9a) and autofit.py's coarse-FFT + refine search from a
    fit/propose.py seed (scale bar / ratio text / picture size, north arrow / north-up, catalog centre). The
    2026-10-10 pre-registered run (docs/autofit.md, FAIL 0/40 seeds) showed: the search works, the relief score
    has false peaks, random-placement nulls cannot accept/reject, and template junk is the binding problem -
    so the design keeps the proven machinery, adds a per-piece keep/drop step (model-classified where the AI
    box is reachable, deterministic no-model fallback otherwise), a search-matched null (same search on a
    scrambled template and a shifted DEM box, whichever scores higher), and the frozen gate + fabrication
    check on the method's own ink pairs as acceptance layers. The 10-10 test sites (US 1848 plates) are none
    of the 19 held-out sites, so their failures are warnings, not predictions.
    Verified by running this session:
    - All 19 hand-fit sites have 0.5-1 m DEMs reachable from this VM: dem_sources probe -> ea (13 England
      sites, EA composite DTM 1 m), usgs (serpent-mound, cahokia, aztalan, mound-bottom), ign (bergues,
      camp-d-attila); all returned finite data for the site box.
    - Plate images: 20 of 21 present in this VM's data/raw (9 books pages under data/raw/books/<ia>/full/,
      11 commons bigs under data/raw/commons/big/); the lead's new maiden-castle c_c20ff6b1f16d173d has only
      its 1280 px thumbnail here - plan_fit.load_picture fetches the big on demand (network, working phase).
    - The AI box is NOT reachable from this VM (127.0.0.1:18080/18083 refused; the 10-10 Qwen calls ran on
      the Mac through its tunnel). Consequence: the model step (page-triage boxes, piece labels) must be
      injectable with a deterministic no-model fallback; the held-out run here is the no-model variant.
    - scikit-image is missing from requirements.in/.txt and from this .venv, but autowalls.py needs it
      (Frangi + skeletonize); 302a pins it (001's archive note anticipated exactly this). .npy is
      gitignored globally, so committed relief seeds are .npz under data/inkfit/ (only data/autofit/*.npz
      is ignored); data/sites/<id>/dem.npy stays a local cache built in the working phase.
    - The lead's 21st hand fit (main 984b1b4, merged from vm/main) is the no-auto version of
      maiden-castle-q1232816.c_c20ff6b1f16d173d.json (3 hand pairs, crop [165,256,895,663]); my branch still

    One trap recorded for the builders: plan_fit.fabrication_pattern clause (b) (1D ladder) fires on >=3
    anchors sharing one coordinate (spread <= 2 px) with near-arithmetic spacing on the other - evenly

### 2026-10-11 302a DECISION: frozen configuration of fit/inkfit.py (recorded BEFORE the first fit run; 10-10 pre-registration discipline - bug fixes allowed later, any parameter change must be labelled exploratory and reported separately)
Session 3: investigation only (all modules the method imports were read in full; llm.py confirmed to have no import-time network; skimage 0.26.0 import-verified in .venv). The method's parameters are frozen here, on a priori ground (reused from the documented 10-10 run), before any site is fitted; the smoke run (next session) happens AFTER this entry. No parameter below may be chosen or changed using any of the 19 held-out sites.
- Extractor: pipeline/autowalls.py P unchanged (docs/autofit.md section 3): sigmas (4,6,9), ridge_thr 0.25, gamma 0.013, coh_sigma 25.0, coh_min 0.6, min_len 50, min_extent 50, normal_sigma 4.0, step 2, margin 20 px. Applied to the picture's panel crop (map_box, or full frame) in the picture's own pixel frame; points later rescaled to the doc's size frame by im.width/size[0].
- No-model fallback rule: NO blanking boxes (the 10-10 auto_noqwen behaviour; the 50-px length filter already drops most lettering) and KEEP ALL surviving pieces. A model (duck-typed: .boxes(im) -> 0-1000-normalised non-map boxes, .label_pieces(im, pieces) -> per-piece kind) may blank non-map boxes and keep only wall-labelled pieces; an absent/unusable answer falls back to the no-model rule and is labelled as such in the result.
- Seed: fit/propose.propose_for (scale bar > ratio at recorded ppi > picture-size; north arrow unless |deg|>60 or unrecorded -> north-up; centre = site centre, i.e. t0 = (0,0) in relief-box-centre metres). Fallback when propose raises (no scale at all): max(size_m)/max(panel px extent), north-up, site centre.
- Search window (reused unchanged from pipeline/autofit.py's frozen 10-10 constants): rotation +-25 deg, scale x0.74..x1.36, centre +-200 m; coarse FFT on an absolute grid ROT_STEP 2 deg, LOGS_STEP 0.04, K_BINS 8 direction bins, CELL_M 4.0 m, NEG_FLOOR -0.2 m; refine = pattern search (0.02/1 deg/4 m -> 0.01/0.5/2 -> 0.005/0.25/1), n_refine 8 candidates, single seed via fit_site with the seed dict at scale_factor 1 / offset 0.
- Objective (selection): mean over template points of max(contrast, -0.2 m); contrast = fit_plate's ridge contrast (relief on the line minus the HIGHER of the two sides side_m away); LRM = aw.local_relief(radius_m 24), clipped +-1.0 m, modern_mask and water_mask set to NaN (fit_plate's defaults; the per-site hand knobs in data/sites/<id>/site.json are hand-fit artefacts and are NEVER read by the method); >= 50% of points on valid relief else score -9.
- Relief: box = aw.site_bbox(site.lon, site.lat, site.size_m or 1000x1000 m), px_m = 1.0 (all held-out and smoke sites have 1 m-class sources, verified in session 1); loader order data/inkfit/relief/<site>.npz (z, px_m, bbox; shape-checked against the expected w x h) -> data/sites/<site>/dem.npy -> aw.fetch_dem (working phase only).
- Null (search-matched, docs/autofit.md finding 2): null = max of the SAME search (identical seed/window/grid/n_refine) over (a) the scrambled template - each piece rigidly rotated U(0,2pi) and translated by U(-0.4,0.4) of the panel extent, clamped inside, all from np.random.default_rng(20261012) - reusing the same Coarse (unchanged ground); and (b) the DEM shifted by half the box north and half east (ndi.shift order=0, cval=NaN; new Coarse). Fewer than 100 valid draws in a null search is recorded (newark's 10-10 problem); a -9 objective counts low.
- Confidence: obj_fit - null (both on the floored-mean objective, metres). The sync-vs-review threshold is NOT set here: box 3 authorises setting it on 302b's held-out table (302c applies it).

### 2026-10-11 302a DECISION: placement->similarity geometry verified; b convention is complex(u0c, -v0c) (MINUS-v) - the session-3 script's +v0c was an 860 m near-miss
Session 4: re-ran the session-3 verification script (kept in the iter-0075 log) and found it had a SECOND bug beyond the noted broadcast fix: it applied M to [du, dv] instead of the autofit convention d = [du, -(v - v0)]. With both fixed (d = [u-u0c, -(v-v0c)], en = d @ M.T + t; lon/lat = aw.to_lonlat(cx + e/k, cy + n/k), k = 1/aw.ground_scale(lat)):
- plan_fit.similarity recovers a = k*s*exp(i*rot) to relative error 7e-6 (= the 1 dp px / 7 dp lon-lat rounding limit of the synthetic pairs), residuals 1.4-4.6 mm; fit_gate.gate accepts (med 3 mm).
- **b = (cx + k*tE) + i(cy + k*tN) - a*complex(u0c, -v0c)** — the minus-v form. The session-3 script used complex(u0c, +v0c) and reported a relative error of 1.3e-4, which looked fine only because |b| ~ 6.6e6 m absorbs the 860 m disagreement. Cross-checked both ways: the solved b matches zc - a*complex(u0,-v0) to the rounding limit, and re-fitting propose._anchor_pairs' 5 pairs recovers that anchor's a and b exactly (a = (m_per_px/ground_scale)*e^(i*rot), b = zc - a*complex(u0, -v0)).
fit/inkfit.py's placement_of and map_pairs must use the minus-v w0 and the flipped-v d; the rest of the design stands as recorded in the task file.

### 2026-10-11 302a DECISION: fit/inkfit.py written per the frozen design (session 5) - module complete, not yet smoke-run on real relief; shifted-DEM null sign corrected to the registration text (content moves half box north + half east)
Session 5: wrote fit/inkfit.py in full (~490 lines: load_panel/_page_picture/_panel_crop, relief/_relief_z/_build_lrm, InkSite mirroring autofit.Site, run_search, seed_for, template_pieces/_model_boxes/_keep_pieces, scramble_pieces, choose_points/_piece_pick, map_pairs, placement_of, _doc, fit, CLI). Imports: pipeline/ (aw, autofit, autowalls, fit_gate, plan_fit) + fit/ (propose); no network at import. batch_us deliberately NOT imported - inkfit._doc copies write_doc's field logic + "fitter":"ink" (batch_us's top-level import is safe, but the doc fields are small and keeping them local keeps the module self-documenting). The method RETURNS the doc, never writes it: whether it is synced or queued for review is 302c's decision, and data/db/platefits/ is not in this task's Touches.
Verified by running this session (all in .venv):
- import inkfit: clean.
- load_panel + seed_for on BOTH real smoke rows (local images, no network): stonehenge-q39671 / earthworkenglan01allcgoog_n0582_1 -> panel 1986x1515, fs 1.0, crop [639.73, 1616.0, 2626.26, 3131.0] (size frame), seed s 0.5034 m/px (picture_size: no scale text), rot 0 (north hint 64.3 deg rejected, |deg|>60). pyramid-mound-q7263260 / ancientmonuments00squi_n0134_1 -> panel 909x529, crop [360.5, 2235.2, 1268.96, 2763.52], seed 0.8806, north-up. Matches the session-4 hand-over expectations exactly.
- Hermetic end-to-end run (throwaway script /tmp/aw-inkfit-herm/run.py against temp root /tmp/aw-inkfit-herm/root; NOT committed - recreate per the hand-over if /tmp is gone): synthetic 120x100 m site with a 72x45 m centred rectangular earthwork saved as data/inkfit/relief/herm-site-q1.npz (z/px_m/bbox/modern-zeros) + a 240x180 drawn-ink plate row (map_box [1/6,1/6,5/6,5/6]; true scale 0.75 = the picture-size seed, rot 0, t 0). fit() completed fully offline in 1.6 s: the npz cache was accepted (shape + px_m + bbox validated), NO OSM or network was touched (modern came from the npz), and it early-returned "no wall ink extracted". Hypothesis: my 5 px drawn lines fall below the frozen extractor's response (Frangi sigmas 4/6/9 at ridge_thr 0.25; coherence cut sigma 25 / min 0.6; min_len/min_extent 50 px) - the real plates' walls are 6-20 px bands, so the SYNTHETIC drawing is too thin/short, not the module. Next session: redraw the synthetic walls 8 px thick (rectangle [72,60,168,120] + interior walls >= 60 px), re-run, then the real-site smoke runs.
- SIGN FIX (a bug fix, not tuning - the magnitudes are the frozen ones): the session-4 task-file note said ndi.shift(lrm, (H_m/2/1.0, W_m/2/1.0)); with scipy's out[i] = in[i - shift] and row index increasing south, both-positive moves the DEM CONTENT half box SOUTH + EAST, but the frozen registration (box 4 entry) says "the DEM shifted by half the box north and half east". Implemented ndi.shift(lrm, (-S.H_m/2/PX_M, +S.W_m/2/PX_M), order=0, cval=np.nan) = content half box north + half east, per the registration. The masks' NaN holes shift with the terrain; water/modern masks are not re-fetched (frozen "masks unchanged").
Remaining (in order): (1) thicken the synthetic drawing, re-run the hermetic script - expect pieces, search, both nulls, pairs, placement, gate, doc offline; (2) smoke-run the two real sites in the working phase (.venv/bin/python fit/inkfit.py <site> <plan>; each fetches dem.npy + the OSM modern mask, ~1-3 min); (3) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q (expect 59 passed / 1 pre-existing test_gate failure owned by 218); (4) commit the module and tick boxes 1 and 3.
